gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-neco: Patrick Hand SC writes like a loose pen, every stroke the same weight, letters crowding shoulder to shoulder. Neco follows as a text serif with a soft swell from hairline to stem, dignified where the heading is offhand.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-plein: Plein is the quiet one here, a sans with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Plein's tidy reliability is the pair's strongest quality, setting off the rope-like, relaxed handwriting of Patrick Hand SC.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads friendly and modern, its curves wide open at the ends. Beside the casual pen strokes of Patrick Hand SC, its strongest quality is that uniform, approachable stroke weight.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-outfit: Outfit bends its strokes like cable, each curve finishing well before it closes. Outfit's uniform line is the pair's strongest quality, leaving Patrick Hand SC to supply the relaxed, scribbled personality.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-plus-jakarta-sans: Patrick Hand SC looks jotted down in a hurry, with crowded letters and no stroke contrast whatsoever. And Plus Jakarta Sans steps in as a precise, monoline sans, its curve endings kept well apart, so the page feels loose and tidy together.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-sora: Patrick Hand SC has a casual, pen-drawn feel, its crowded letters hugging shoulders with no variation in stroke. Sora's precision is the real gift: geometric, widely parted curves.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe. Patrick Hand SC is best at relaxed, scribbled charm, while Space Grotesk is best at geometric, level-headed clarity.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is tall, rounded and dignified, with a gaping c. Phudu's tubing-like lines make a loud, constant-width headline, so a modest body size beside it looks natural.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fauna-one: Chunky, ballpoint-plain lettering up top, with generous openings on every curve. Fauna One then settles into a literary, dignified rhythm.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-glegoo: Loud, pipe-bent letters with constant-width arms and legs, open at every curve. Glegoo's big counters keep a longer read refined.
